questions.q: Two runs: `echo hi > f.txt`, then `echo yo > f.txt`. What does f.txt hold now?
choices: just yo - a single > wipes the file before writing
just hi - the second write was refused

questions.q: What does the pipe `|` actually connect?
choices: the left command's output to the right command's input
your terminal to a second terminal
a command to its manual page

questions.q: Which grep flag INVERTS the match - printing only lines that do NOT contain the word? (dash included)
Why does `uniq -c` need `sort` in front of it?
choices: uniq is case-sensitive and sort fixes the case
uniq only compares each line with its direct neighbor, so repeats must stand together first
uniq refuses to open unsorted files
sort strips the blank lines uniq chokes on

questions.q: In `cut -d: -f1`, which flag names the separator character? (dash included)
After `uniq -c`, which sort flags reorder the tally biggest-count-first, comparing as numbers?
questions.hint_format: a dash and two letters, as you'd type them

choices: lines inside each letter file, added up
entries in the letters folder - ls printed one name per line and wc counted lines
